title: CrossFit

services.name: Performance Clinics
services.desc: Our Specialty Classes are focused training courses designed to help you master specific skills that don’t always get the time they deserve in regular classes. These sessions run longer than a standard class and take place in a small group setting, allowing for deeper coaching, more reps, and real technical progress. Each specialty class is a structured training block with intentional programming. There is no metcon. Instead, the focus is on learning, refining, and building confidence in complex movements. Barbell Specialty Classes break down the Olympic lifts including the snatch, clean, and clean and jerk. You’ll develop better positions, timing, and efficiency so your lifts feel stronger,

explain.meaning: A group lesson focused on one skill.

services.name: Personal Training
services.desc: One on one coaching designed to meet you where you are and take you where you want to go. Every session is customized to your goals, your schedule, and your ability, with expert coaching and accountability every step of the way. Your coach builds a structured plan based on your experience, movement quality, and long term objectives, adjusting as you progress. Sessions focus on safe, effective training that improves strength, conditioning, and overall confidence. You’ll receive consistent feedback, clear direction, and support that keeps you moving forward without guesswork.
